parsed.change_summary: Added a check to ensure the input value does not exceed the range of int64_t.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger is blocked by adding a check to ensure the input value does not exceed the range of int64_t. If the input value is INT64_MIN or INT64_MAX, the program will print 'Value out of range' instead of proceeding with the normal execution.
parsed.behavior_changes: The program now checks if the input value is INT64_MIN or INT64_MAX and prints 'Value out of range' in such cases. For other valid inputs, the behavior remains the same.
